worldcombat.skill.synthesis.summary: Spreads its leaves in place and turns the sunlight falling on it into health: the brighter the spot, the more it restores, close to two thirds at clear noon but only a little in shade or at night; it cannot move while absorbing.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.use.0: A large heal under open sun
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.use.1: A small heal in the shade
Restores %1$s of the missing health: higher with brighter sunlight (close to 2/3 at clear noon), only the minimum floor at night or under cover; higher Special Defence makes the leaves tougher.
Spreads its leaves to absorb light and stands still for %1$s; being interrupted spends no PP.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.timing: A self move; it stands still for %1$s s of wind-up, then spends %3$s PP, recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.preference.a: Below this health ratio the companion schedules Synthesis; lower endures longer, higher spreads its leaves at the first wound.
Below this sunlight the companion holds the move and waits for a brighter spot; lower also heals in shade, higher only casts in strong noon light.
Cannot be used while at full health.
